seed: uk bass, dubstep, grime, garage, bass music

required_records.title: King Tubby Meets Rockers Uptown
required_records.why: source 5: dub reggae foundation for UK bass sound; both Augustus Pablo and King Tubby are cited as originators of the dub philosophy UK bass producers inherit

required_records.title: Anti War Dub
required_records.why: source 5: 'Digital Mystikz brought an expanded palette of sounds and influences to the genre, most prominently reggae and dub.' Mala is the definitive dubstep founder; this track demonstrates the reggae-dub ancestry that runs through all UK bass

required_records.title: Hyph Mngo
required_records.why: source 5 and 6: Joy Orbison bridges dubstep and future garage; appears in the catalogue at 5 sets. Hyph Mngo is the canonical 2010s UK bass sound

required_records.title: Scary Monsters and Nice Sprites
required_records.why: source 5: 'the harsher electro-house and heavy metal-influenced variant brostep, led by American producers such as Skrillex, boosted dubstep's popularity in the United States.' The page's umbrella covers both UK dubstep origins and international brostep; this is the second half of that story

required_records.title: Love Dub
required_records.why: source 6: Cooly G appears at 5 sets in the catalogue and is catalogue-only, absent from all competing canonical lists. Hyperdub artist representing the female producers and singers UK bass depends on

required_records.title: Eskimo
required_records.why: source 5: grime's founding moment; Wiley's early tracks define grime's emergence from UK garage and its percussion-first philosophy, central to understanding UK bass as an umbrella

required_records.title: Original Nuttah
required_records.why: source 5 and source 6: jungle's amen break breakpoint; Shy FX carries jungle's percussive assault into UK garage and bass culture, making this the ancestral record for the whole umbrella

required_records.title: Inner City Life
required_records.why: source 5 and source 6: drum and bass pioneer; this liquid drum and bass track is the sound-world parent for UK garage's synth sensibilities and bass music's melodic possibilities

known_gaps.title: Deliberate media restraint, 6 September 2026
known_gaps.why: Midnight Request Line, Night and the proto-dubstep records are named in this guide's prose and embedded on the dubstep guide instead. Running the same players on both pages would break the rule against reusing media across guides, and the umbrella guide's job is to point at the scene guide, not to duplicate it. Recorded so a later canon pass does not read these as missing embeds.
